# Beag Labs — Full Context for LLMs

> Small Model Foundry. Domain-specific classification and extraction models trained on your proprietary data. Deploy on-prem, air-gapped, or in your VPC. No APIs. No data leakage. You own the model.

## What Beag Labs Does

Beag Labs is a small model foundry that builds custom small language models (SLMs, 500M-5B parameters) for classification, extraction, and relevance tasks in regulated and data-sensitive environments. Unlike frontier API providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google), Beag Labs trains models you own and deploy on your own infrastructure — on-premises, air-gapped, or in your VPC — with no runtime API calls, no data leakage, and no vendor lock-in.

## How It Works

The platform pipeline:

1. **Connect data** — OAuth connectors (Gmail, GitHub, HubSpot, Notion) or CSV upload. Data stays in your environment.
2. **Auto-label** — Frontier models (GPT-4, Claude) generate initial labels on your data.
3. **Disagreement engine** — The system surfaces only the 2-5% of edge cases where frontier models disagree, for human review. This minimizes labeling cost while maintaining quality.
4. **Fine-tune** — A small language model (500M-5B parameters) is fine-tuned on the labeled data.
5. **Export as ONNX** — The trained model is exported as ONNX format for deployment anywhere: cloud, on-prem, or fully air-gapped.

From raw data to deployed model typically takes under 24 hours.

## Domain Model Families

- **Compliance SLMs** — NIST 800-53 control classification, policy-to-control mapping, evidence sufficiency scoring, gap analysis flagging. Status: In Training.
- **Security SLMs** — Vulnerability severity triage, CVE-to-OWASP mapping, threat report classification, MITRE ATT&CK technique labeling. Status: On Deck.
- **Legal SLMs** — E-discovery relevance classification, privilege review triage, contract clause extraction, regulatory filing categorization. Status: Planned.
- **Healthcare SLMs** — Clinical document triage, adverse event classification, prior authorization extraction, FDA submission categorization. Status: Planned.

All domain models are fine-tuned on your proprietary data before delivery. You own the trained model weights.

## Key Differentiators

- **Up to 13x cheaper** than per-token frontier API pricing at production scale, because you run inference on your own hardware with no API calls.
- **No data leakage** — Your data never leaves your environment during inference. No runtime API calls to Beag Labs or any third party.
- **You own the model** — Exported as ONNX. No vendor lock-in, no API dependency, no subscription required to run inference.
- **Air-gapped deployment** — Models work in fully disconnected environments. No internet access needed at runtime.
- **Under 24 hours** from raw data to deployed model.

## Pricing

Beag Labs offers two engagement models:

### Done-For-You (Custom Model Build)
Beag Labs designs the labeling schema, runs the intelligent labeling pipeline, co-reviews edge cases with your team, trains the model, and ships a deployable ONNX export. Price: Custom, engagement-based. Timeline: Under 24 hours after schema alignment.

### Platform (Train It Yourself)
Use the Beag Labs platform to run the training pipeline yourself with your own data. Full access to data connectors, labeling, training, and export pipeline. Price: Custom, contact us.

See https://beaglabs.com/pricing.md for full pricing details.

## Engagement Models

Beag Labs also offers a **Domain Intelligence Pilot** — a 12-week engagement that builds a custom AI model for your organization through discovery workshops, data integration, domain modeling, and deployment in your secure environment.

See https://beaglabs.com/design-partnerships for details.

## Technology

- **Model size:** 500M-5B parameters (small language models)
- **Export format:** ONNX (Open Neural Network Exchange)
- **Data connectors:** Gmail, GitHub, HubSpot, Notion (OAuth), CSV upload
- **Labeling:** Frontier model auto-labeling + disagreement engine for human review of edge cases
- **Deployment:** On-premises, air-gapped, VPC, or any infrastructure that runs ONNX
